item.title: Trump pushes Zelenskyy to end war with Russia as fuel prices rise with midterms looming
item.description: President Trump is claiming Ukrainian President Zelenskyy has the power to end the country's war with Russia as Americans feel the impact of rising fuel prices with midterms just a few weeks away. CBS News' Charlie D'Agata and Natalie Brand report.

item.title: Up to 20% of MS diagnoses may be wrong, like Christina Applegate's
item.description: A multiple sclerosis expert answers questions about MS misdiagnosis after Christina Applegate said she doesn't have the chronic condition after all.

item.title: Sen. Blumenthal accuses Trump of "trying to bleed Ukrainians into conceding territory and security"
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy met with U.S. special envoy Steve Witkoff in Norway on Tuesday. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said U.S. intelligence sharing with Ukraine has been restored. Democratic Sen. Richard Blumenthal of Connecticut joins "The Takeout" with his reaction.

item.title: Doctor on Christina Applegate's MS misdiagnosis
item.description: Actress Christina Applegate revealed on Tuesday that her years-long battle with multiple sclerosis was not MS at all, and she was misdiagnosed. Dr. Marwa Kaisey, an associate professor at the Cedars-Sinai Medical Center Department of Neurology, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Ohio race takes ugly turn with ad featuring Amy Acton's mother
item.description: Democrat Amy Acton's estranged mother calls her a liar in a new GOP ad. Acton's brother says the ad marks a "despicable low" and says their stepfather sexually abused Acton when she was a child.

item.title: New attack ad targeting Ohio gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton features her estranged mother
item.description: A new attack ad posted on social media spotlights Ohio Democratic gubernatorial nominee Amy Acton's estranged mother, who calls her daughter a liar. Ohio Capital Journal author Nick Evans joins CBS News to discuss the reaction to the ad.

item.title: Bill Clinton campaigns in Florida for Democratic gubernatorial candidate David Jolly
item.description: Former President Bill Clinton is traveling to Florida Tuesday night to campaign for Democratic gubernatorial candidate David Jolly. He's one of the many well-known candidates helping with that campaign. CBS News' Cristian Benavides reports on the visit.

item.title: French government extends curfews after riots sweep across the country
item.description: French authorities are extending curfews and increasing the police presence in public spaces as President Emmanuel Macron's government tries to regain control after rioters torched buildings and looted thousands of businesses this weekend.

item.title: Trump says U.S. has "gotten nothing back" from Ukraine "other than high diesel"
item.description: President Trump on Tuesday continued his public feud with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, saying the leader "has to want to settle" the Russia-Ukraine war and criticizing him for not doing so. CBS News congressional correspondent Nikole Killion reports.

item.title: Trump says U.S. will pay fraud whistleblowers, and he'll decide who is paid
item.description: President Trump said successful whistleblowers will get 1% of any fraud they report, although there may be limits.

item.title: Alabama governor commutes death sentence of man convicted of 1995 murder
item.description: Alabama Gov. Kay Ivey said she was commuting Toforest Johnson's death sentence to life in prison without parole.

item.title: Iran touts closest ever ties with Russia, contradicting Trump
item.description: Iran says its ties with Russia are stronger than ever after a visit by Putin's top envoy, challenging Trump's assertion that Moscow isn't helping Iran in the war.

item.title: Hegseth meets Netanyahu ahead of elections, possible Iran war restart
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth made an unannounced visit to Israel just over a week before Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stands for elections, and as President Trump floats restarting the Iran war.

item.title: U.S. ramps up warnings to Americans in Middle East after Houthi strikes
item.description: U.S. diplomatic missions across the Middle East have issued a new round of warnings to Americans amid attacks by Iran-backed Houthi militants against Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Virginia daycare temporarily shut down after 2-year-old puts loaded gun in mouth
item.description: A Richmond, Virginia, daycare has been temporarily shut down after a 2-year-old put a loaded gun in their mouth. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul has more.

item.title: Cornell responds to Jane Doe letter saying she felt disbelieved
item.description: Cornell has denied claims made in a letter from a former student, known as Jane Doe, about a remark by the school's president.

item.title: Amazon to hire 300,000 workers for seasonal jobs this year
item.description: The online retailer plans to sharply boost its hiring for the holiday season this year. Here's what kind of positions they're looking to fill and how much they pay.

item.title: 3 more Democrats slated to join summit on political future
item.description: Sens. Cory Booker and Chris Van Hollen and Rep. Ro Khanna are among the latest additions to a post-midterm gathering in Denver, where Democrats will strategize about the future of the party.

item.title: Booker, Khanna and Van Hollen to join potential 2028 Democratic hopefuls at midterm summit
item.description: Sens. Cory Booker, Ro Khanna, and Chris Van Hollen have all signaled their intent to join a midterm summit for possible 2028 Democratic hopefuls. CBS News' Jared Ochacher has more.

item.title: Gun used in Bend school shooting was birthday gift from shooter's mom
item.description: The Maverick 88 pump-action 12-gauge shotgun was purchased legally in August 2026 by Shauntai Nickerson, the mother of the shooter, and given to him for recreational use, sources told CBS News.

item.title: Trump announces $8 billion in diesel relief for U.S. farmers
item.description: The USDA said farmers don't need crop insurance to qualify and can prepare to apply by creating a Login.gov account.

item.title: Christina Applegate reveals she was misdiagnosed with MS
item.description: Christina Applegate said on her MeSsy podcast that her doctor recently revealed she did not have multiple sclerosis.

item.title: Trump administration health leaders break down new women's health initiative
item.description: Director of the National Institutes of Health Dr. Jay Bhattacharya and Director of the Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health Dr. Alicia Jackson sit down with "CBS Mornings" to discuss President Trump's executive order creating a women's health division within the NIH.

item.title: "Frasier" star Jane Leeves talks about her career, Kelsey Grammer and more
item.description: Jane Leeves, who is best known for her role of Daphne Moon on the hit sitcom "Frasier," sits down with "CBS Mornings" to talk about her new memoir, "Daphne & Me: My Life on Frasier (And a Bit More)."

item.title: What to know about Jalen Hurts' blood clot diagnosis
item.description: Jalen Hurts' agent and the Eagles said in a statement Monday his "prognosis is very good, and we anticipate a full recovery."

item.title: Trump "should apply his creativity" to end Russia's war, Ukrainian parliament member says
item.description: U.S. officials will participate in Ukraine-Russia peace talks in Norway. This comes as President Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy trade barbs over strained relations. Ukrainian parliament member Halyna Yanchenko weighs in.

item.title: Walmart introduces discounted joint membership with Sam's Club
item.description: Amid stubbornly high inflation, the retailer is offering a combined Walmart+ and Sam's Club Plus membership for $120 a year.

item.title: Trump signs executive order on women's health
item.description: "Who the hell wouldn't have a women's health division?" President Trump said Monday.

item.title: Longtime 76ers season ticket holders priced out as cost skyrockets
item.description: Lifelong Philadelphia 76ers fans and longtime season ticket holders Aaron Selkow and his father Don tell Jonah Kaplan why they decided not to renew this year amid skyrocketing prices.

item.title: Theranos whistleblower weighs in on Nathan Fielder's Elizabeth Holmes documentary
item.description: Tyler Shultz, a former Theranos insider and the company's 2015 whistleblower, joins "CBS Mornings" to discuss Nathan Fielder's blockbuster Elizabeth Holmes documentary "You Can See Everything."
